tests.name: Test 1.1 - Buttons appear in a clear shell location
tests.purpose: Confirm the static flow-entry buttons are visible in the intended shell area and read as primary shortcuts rather than transcript content.

rows.action: Open the main chat page on a desktop-width viewport.
rows.what_is_tested: The button group is visible without needing to interact first.

rows.action: Inspect the visual placement relative to the header, transcript, and input area.
rows.what_is_tested: The buttons feel like shell-level navigation and not like a bot message.

tests.name: Test 2.1 - `Каталог` enters catalog flow
tests.purpose: Confirm the catalog button immediately engages the catalog/service-list path.

rows.action: Load a fresh main chat session and click `Каталог`.
rows.what_is_tested: The click triggers the catalog-oriented flow immediately without requiring typed input first.

rows.action: Inspect the immediate assistant response after clicking `Каталог`.
rows.what_is_tested: The response reflects catalog or service-list behavior rather than a generic fallback.

tests.name: Test 2.2 - `Слободни термин` enters scheduling flow
tests.purpose: Confirm the free-slots button immediately engages availability discovery.

rows.action: Load a fresh main chat session and click `Слободни термин`.
rows.what_is_tested: The click triggers scheduling or availability behavior immediately.

rows.action: Inspect the immediate assistant response and any attached widget behavior.
rows.what_is_tested: The result reflects availability discovery rather than catalog or generic chat.

tests.name: Test 2.3 - `Закажи` enters booking-oriented flow
tests.purpose: Confirm the booking button immediately engages the safest existing booking-entry path.

rows.action: Load a fresh main chat session and click `Закажи`.
rows.what_is_tested: The click triggers booking-oriented guidance or booking entry without requiring the user to type first.

rows.action: Inspect the immediate assistant response after clicking `Закажи`.
rows.what_is_tested: The result matches the intended booking-entry contract and does not fall back to an unrelated flow.

tests.name: Test 3.1 - Typed chat still works after using buttons
tests.purpose: Confirm the new shell buttons do not break the normal typed-input chat path.

rows.action: After using one of the static buttons, type and send a normal user message.
rows.what_is_tested: The existing text-input path still submits and receives a reply correctly.

tests.name: Test 3.2 - Layout remains usable on narrow width
tests.purpose: Confirm the shell-level buttons remain usable on a smaller viewport.

rows.action: Open the main chat page at a narrow mobile-like width.
rows.what_is_tested: The buttons remain visible, tappable, and do not break the shell layout.
